summary: CWE-253: FileInputStream.read(byte[]) returns the number of bytes read, or -1 when the stream has reached end-of-file; it does not return 0 to signal EOF (0 only occurs when the requested length is 0). Checking the return value against 0 incorrectly interprets the result, so the EOF condition is never detected. The fix compares the return value against -1, the documented end-of-stream sentinel, preserving the read/report behavior.
